mktAbout.subtitle: We build tools that let startups and global enterprises automate user conversations without sacrificing human warmth or client experience.
mktAbout.v1Desc: We build intent classification agents that understand natural slangs, regional languages, and details, ensuring customers get accurate replies.
mktAbout.v2Desc: CRMs shouldn't be boring spreadsheets. We build clean, high-motion, visual boards that make managing relationships a joy.
mktAbout.v3Desc: We focus on Apple-level polish, Stripe-level documentation, and rock-solid Meta API compliance.

mktAboutUs.subtitle: Whasalia is an AI-powered WhatsApp CRM platform helping businesses automate customer communication, manage leads, improve customer support, and streamline operations using the official WhatsApp Business API in accordance with Meta guidelines.
mktAboutUs.servicesSubtitle: Enterprise-grade utilities designed to accelerate customer engagement

services.crmDesc: Manage WhatsApp chat threads in a high-fidelity kanban board. Categorize discussions, assign pipelines, track estimated deal values, and tag leads without losing context.
services.leadsDesc: Capture lead profiles instantly from Click-to-WhatsApp ads or inbound queries. Segment lists, apply user-defined properties, and assign custom variables to optimize sales follow-ups.
services.botsDesc: Train smart customer-facing assistants on your company documentation, FAQs, and product catalogs. Resolve queries autonomously 24/7 with natural context understanding.
services.apptDesc: Sync bookings and client meetings directly through WhatsApp chats. Allow users to check slots and reserve consultations, sending dynamic automated invites automatically.
services.supportDesc: Route inquiries to proper team queues, handle recurrent queries through instant replies, and configure fallback mechanisms for human-agent handovers.
services.workflowDesc: Connect events and external APIs (such as Shopify checkouts or CRM updates) to trigger message alerts, payment reminders, or status changes in real-time.
services.teamDesc: Unify customer communication in a collaborative shared team inbox. Co-assign threads, write internal notes, and manage agent permissions from a unified view.
